name: Crispy Rice & Salmon Ponzu Salad
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray with baking parchment.

Tip the cooked rice onto the tray and toss with the sesame seeds, olive oil and a good pinch of salt. Spread it out into one even layer, slide into the oven and bake for 30-35 mins, flipping halfway, until golden and properly crispy.

Meanwhile, tip the spinach and frozen edamame into a colander. Pour over freshly boiled kettle water until the spinach is wilted and the edamame defrosted. Leave to cool slightly, then squeeze out as much excess water as you can.
Trim the cucumber, halve it lengthways and scoop out the watery seeds with a spoon, then thinly slice.
Juice the lemon into a large bowl. Add the white miso, soy sauce and sesame oil, then whisk until smooth. Add the spinach, edamame and cucumber and toss to coat.

Place a frying pan over a medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Season the salmon with salt, then add to the pan skin side down. Cook undisturbed for 5-7 mins, until about three-quarters cooked through. Remove from the heat, flip the salmon skin side up and leave to finish cooking in the residual heat. Break into large flakes.
Once the rice is crispy, add it to the bowl with the dressed veg, then gently toss through the salmon. Share between plates and enjoy.
